notes: Scope is selective primary-text inspection for novelty, not a full dossier of these additional references. Downloaded does not imply reviewed. REFLECT was downloaded but excluded as discovery-only.

sources.title: Language-Aligned Waypoint (LAW) Supervision for Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
sources.material_inspected: PDF pp.1–5,8,10–11; §3 and Table1; selected supplementary discussion; source files in code ledger.
sources.source_supported_finding: Goal-only supervision can depart from instruction intent. LAW chooses a reference waypoint from current geometry and asks a shortest-path follower for one action. The inspected active geodesic teacher does not consult completed instruction obligations. This does not imply that every teacher in the repository is stateless.

sources.title: Reward Machines for Deep RL in Noisy and Uncertain Environments
sources.material_inspected: PDF pp.4–7; §4, §5.1–5.4, Algorithm1, Table1; detector and supervised-training code.
sources.source_supported_finding: TDM directly predicts a distribution over reward-machine states from history. A recurrent detector is supervised on task states. The analysis shows that independently propagating uncertain proposition estimates can mishandle correlated evidence. These are direct predecessors of P1's proposed soft history-conditioned state.

sources.title: Optimal Completion Distillation for Sequence Learning
sources.authors: Sara Sabour, William Chan, Mohammad Norouzi
sources.material_inspected: PDF pp.2–3; §3 Eqs.(4)–(6). OpenReview retrieval failed; arXiv v2 inspected.
sources.source_supported_finding: A model-generated prefix receives all next-token extensions attaining the optimal attainable completion score. At zero temperature the target is uniform over ties; training minimizes KL to that target. This is not identical to P1's marginal acceptable-set loss.

sources.title: Does the Question Really Matter? Training-Free Data Selection for Vision-Language SFT
sources.source_supported_finding: Frozen-model conditional validity contrasts reject semantic conflicts and prioritize difficult positive examples near the admissibility boundary. Raw YES/NO probabilities are not a normalized binary pair. No human-verified navigation clause-witness validity protocol is established by the inspected method.

sources.title: Dataset Cartography: Mapping and Diagnosing Datasets with Training Dynamics
sources.source_supported_finding: Confidence and variability describe model-relative training dynamics. Noise analysis includes blinded human relabelling. Difficulty and annotation validity cannot be identified merely by renaming these scores. Code computes gold-label probabilities over training epochs.

sources.title: Generating Vision-Language Navigation Instructions Incorporated Fine-Grained Alignment Annotations
sources.publication_status: arXiv June 2025 version inspected; publisher listing discovered, journal version not inspected
sources.source_supported_finding: FCA-NIG generates sub-instruction/sub-trajectory and entity/landmark alignment annotations using trajectory chunking, GLIP, OFA-Speaker and CLIP matching. It establishes that constructing fine-grained synthetic alignment evidence is not itself new. Its automatic matching is distinct from independent semantic-validity adjudication.

sources.title: Predictive Representations of State
sources.authors: Michael L. Littman, Richard S. Sutton, Satinder Singh
sources.material_inspected: PDF pp.1,3 (scanned PDF interleaves blank pages); definition and explicit two-step conditional joint prediction.
sources.source_supported_finding: State representations based on action-conditional sequences of future observations already encode ordered joint predictive tests. P3's selected event pairs are not a complete predictive state representation and do not inherit its sufficiency guarantee.

sources.title: Horde: A Scalable Real-time Architecture for Learning Knowledge from Unsupervised Sensorimotor Interaction
sources.material_inspected: PDF pp.2–3; §§2–4 and return definition Eq.(1).
sources.source_supported_finding: General value functions allow distinct policies, termination, transient rewards and terminal rewards for predictive questions. P3's finite-horizon ordered-event probability is an instance after adding an event monitor; the reduction is this review's deduction.

sources.title: Distributional Successor Features Enable Zero-Shot Policy Optimization
sources.material_inspected: PDF pp.3–4; §3 model assumptions and distributional successor-feature construction.
sources.source_supported_finding: Models distributions of long-term feature outcomes rather than their average. This overlaps branch-aware future representation. It does not establish that arbitrary ordering queries are recoverable from every unaugmented occupancy-feature vector.

sources.title: A Distributional Analogue to the Successor Representation
sources.authors: Harley Wiltzer, Jesse Farebrother et al.
sources.source_supported_finding: Distributional successor measures preserve distributions over occupancy measures, distinguishing outcome modes obscured by a mean. This is broader distributional prior art, not an exact proof that occupancy representations recover all temporal orders.

sources.title: Reflect After Failure: Brain-Inspired Self-Evolving Agents for Embodied Spatial Intelligence
sources.source_supported_finding: Failure diagnosis conditions selective strategy/skill memory revision. Retrospective diagnosis can use privileged simulator metadata. Evidence contracts enforce structured linkage/consistency; the appendix does not claim independent geometric verification. No negative object-identity bank was demonstrated in these inspected sections.

sources.title: EmbodiSkill: Skill-Aware Reflection for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
sources.material_inspected: PDF pp.1–8, especially §3.2.1–3.2.2; official routing code.
sources.source_supported_finding: Reflection distinguishes skill defects from execution lapses. Execution-lapse evidence preserves valid skill-body guidance and receives separate notes; code routes these classes differently. This directly anticipates protecting persistent knowledge from misattributed task failure, though its knowledge object is a skill manual.

sources.title: Finding Where the Buck Stops: An Automated Failure Attribution-Based Reflection Framework for Multi-Agent Collaboration
sources.publication_status: arXiv v1 28 August 2026; authors report EMNLP 2026 main acceptance
sources.source_supported_finding: An attributed decisive error controls which agent reflects, explicitly to avoid contaminating other agents' memory. Process-reward-based step selection and counterfactual correction are not independently grounded physical identity witnesses. This occupies the generic diagnosis-before-memory-update rationale.

sources.title: Where Did It Go Wrong? Capability-Oriented Failure Attribution for Vision-and-Language Navigation Agents
sources.material_inspected: arXiv PDF pp.5,8,12–14; §4.2, AppendixA.4. Official publication metadata checked. README/tree and main.py inspected.
sources.source_supported_finding: Capability-specific oracles and counterfactual repair localize navigation failures. The inspected main.py performs task/trajectory generation, not the oracle-repair method; its presence is not implementation verification of the full method. The paper supports attribution controls, not P4's persistent semantic-bank rule.

sources.title: PSG-Nav official implementation
sources.material_inspected: PSG_Nav.py:1492–1563 and utils/rag_manager.py:277–302, commit181d878ff207845a31e542a19a6592925c1e9bab; files independently read from assignments03/10 snapshots.
sources.source_supported_finding: When collection is enabled, terminal failure writes sliding-window detections to the negative bank. Retrieval can reject similar future detections before positive matching. This establishes a reachable code mechanism, not observed frequency, benchmark harm, default activation or a paper-level result.

sources.title: Ground-Compose-Reinforce: Grounding Language in Agentic Behaviours using Limited Data
sources.authors: Andrew Li, Toryn Klassen, Andrew Wang, Parand Alamdari, Sheila McIlraith
sources.source_supported_finding: Grounding predictions drive reward-machine task state; state-conditioned policies operate in the product task/environment representation. P1 cannot claim this composition itself as new. Only the stated sections and wrapper were independently inspected here.
